Information for visitors

Telephone

Our switchboard can connect you to a named individual or help you find the appropriate department if you're not sure who you need to talk to.

  • Calls from the UK: 0114 222 2000
  • International calls: +44 114 222 2000
  • Sheffield Teaching Hospitals: 0114 226 9690

If you're a member of University staff looking for the restricted-access internal phone directory then you'll find it at the top of the page under My services > Telephone directory.
